user.title: Connect to SmartThings
user.description: Sign in directly to Samsung with this integration’s own OAuth application, or enter a manual access token. OAuth automatically refreshes your tokens.

device.title: Choose a Samsung EHS heat pump
device.description: Only devices exposing Samsung EHS capabilities are listed.

token.title: Use a manual SmartThings token
token.description: Enter a SmartThings personal access token with permission to read devices. The integration only sends read-only API requests.

error.invalid_auth: SmartThings access denied. Sign in again or check the manual token.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach SmartThings. Try again later.
error.no_devices: No compatible EHS device is accessible through this connection. When reconfiguring, the existing heat pump must be accessible.

abort.missing_refresh_token: SmartThings did not return a refresh token. Check the OAuth app settings and authorize again.
abort.missing_scopes: The OAuth authorization must include read access to devices.
abort.no_devices: No compatible EHS device is accessible through this connection. When reconfiguring, the existing heat pump must be accessible.
abort.invalid_auth: SmartThings access denied. Sign in again or check the manual token.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to reach SmartThings. Try again later.

init.title: Samsung EHS settings
init.description: Select the Shelly (or other) power sensor measuring the heat pump. Supports W or kW. This replaces Samsung instantaneous power for live COP and daily energy/COP; seven-day electricity still uses the Samsung energy counter. Clear the selection to use Samsung again. If the chosen sensor is unavailable, live power and COP remain unknown without fallback. Enable the managed dashboard to add a sidebar dashboard for this heat pump. Sensor IDs are resolved automatically. Disable it to remove only the managed dashboard. Copy its configuration to a separate dashboard for customization.

error.own_sensor: Choose a sensor from another integration, such as Shelly, to avoid a circular dependency.
error.invalid_power_unit: The sensor must measure power in W or kW, not energy in Wh or kWh.
